experience.title: FlowLedger — Personal Financial Tracker
experience.description: Production-grade local-first personal financial tracking engine built with Go standard library net/http, Vue 3, and pure-Go SQLite WAL. Implements Pragmatic Clean Architecture with consumer-defined interfaces, deterministic integer IDR arithmetic, Idempotency-Key double-spend protection, errgroup concurrent monthly analytics, and memory-safe streaming CSV export shipped in a single embedded binary.
highlights: Strict Deterministic Integer Math: Custom AmountIDR int64 representation preventing floating-point rounding errors across SQLite, domain entities, and API payloads
Clean Architecture & Standard Library: Pure Go 1.22 net/http routing, consumer-defined repository interfaces, and WithTx closure transaction boundaries
Idempotency & Double-Posting Protection: Idempotency-Key middleware caching request hashes to prevent duplicate transaction entries on network retry
Concurrent Monthly Analytics: Parallel multi-query execution via errgroup delivering sub-50ms financial aggregations and budget status calculations
SQLite Concurrency Tuning: Configured WAL journal mode, busy timeout, and strict foreign keys preventing database lock contention
Single-Binary Asset Embedding: Vue 3 Vite build embedded directly into Go binary via go:embed for zero-dependency self-contained deployment
experience.metrics: Deterministic Integer Math · <50ms Concurrency · Single Binary (embed.FS)

experience.title: MeteoPulse — Interactive Weather Forecast & DSP Digital Filter Lab
experience.description: Interactive meteorological web application and Digital Signal Processing (DSP) laboratory built with Node.js/Express 5 and Modern Vanilla ES6+. Treats satellite temperature time-series as discrete-time signals x[n] and applies FIR Low-Pass Simple Moving Average (SMA) and IIR Exponential Moving Average (EMA) filters to reduce micro-climate transient noise by up to 70%, featuring OpenLayers GIS spatial radar maps, dynamic multi-city trend comparisons, and raw data CSV export.
highlights: DSP Digital Filter Pipeline: Implemented discrete-time FIR Simple Moving Average (SMA) and IIR Exponential Moving Average (EMA) low-pass filters to suppress satellite temperature noise with dynamic window sizing (M = 3 to 6)
Noise Reduction Variance Metric: Formulated real-time first-difference absolute variation metric quantifying up to 70% transient fluctuation damping across diurnal cycles
Interactive OpenLayers GIS Integration: Integrated OpenStreetMap radar canvas featuring pulsating coordinate pins, instant weather popups, and click-to-geolocate reverse geocoding
Multi-City Comparative Analytics: Engineered multi-parameter trend comparisons across 5 cities simultaneously using Chart.js with dynamic metric toggling (Max, Min, Mean, Wind, Rain)
3-Tier Bento Grid UI Architecture: Built lightweight glassmorphism interface in Modern Vanilla ES6+ and Tailwind CSS achieving sub-800ms load times with zero framework runtime overhead
Raw Data Audit & CSV Export: Provided tabular numerical inspection with parameter filters and one-click RFC 4180 CSV analytical export for climate researchers
experience.metrics: Up to 70% Noise Reduction · <800ms Load Time · 3-Tier Bento Grid

experience.title: CineMax TIX — Enterprise Cinema Ticketing & Concession Platform
experience.description: Enterprise-grade cinema ticketing and food & beverage (F&B) platform engineered with Spring Boot 4 (Java 25) and Modular Vanilla ES6+ JavaScript. Re-engineered from a legacy semester 3 monolithic application into a high-concurrency architecture implementing clean code design patterns, 300-second Time-To-Live (TTL) seat reservation holding, database-level Pessimistic Write Locking (PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) to prevent race conditions during ticket rush, Strategy Pattern payment processing (QRIS & Cash), integrated concession upselling, and physical self-service kiosk thermal printing simulation.
highlights: High-Concurrency Seat Locking with TTL Hold: Implemented 5-minute Time-To-Live (300s) seat reservation holding and database-level Pessimistic Write Locking (PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) preventing race conditions and double-booking during ticket rush
Strategy Pattern Payment Engine: Decoupled transaction settlement via PaymentStrategyFactory supporting dynamic QRIS online verification and cash payment computation adhering to Open/Closed Principle
Interactive Tiered Seat Map & Concessions: Engineered responsive visual cinema seating layout (Satine Suite, Sweet Box, Regular) with integrated F&B upselling cart and instant subtotal calculation
Self-Service Kiosk Simulator & Dynamic Barcode: Built end-to-end digital ticketing flow generating unique claim codes, dynamic 1D barcodes, and physical kiosk thermal print animation

Architectural Re-engineering & SRP: Refactored legacy monolithic application into modular Spring Boot services with standardized ApiResponse<T> envelope, global exception handling (@ControllerAdvice), and 100% JUnit 5 test pass rate
experience.metrics: Pessimistic Locking · 300s TTL Hold · Strategy Pattern · 100% JUnit Pass
